## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Hannah Altmann [10. November 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.180
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.180
- Datum: 10.11.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Petropolis, 10.XI. 41
My dear Hanna, We just received your letter of Oct. 22nd which we had been
awaiting impatiently, as your last letter was from Oct. 6th. - As to Eva
I don't think you need worry (although I fully understand how you feel
when you get a homesick letter). In one letter Eva complained a little
later she sounded as cheerful and happy as usual. That girl Renk I
strongly developed girl of about 14, and I believe there was talk that she
was to visit the same class as Eva. Mrs. Sch. in her last letter to
us mentioned that there was some friction between the two girls and
that Eva did not seem to like it if one gave a good word to Irene.
The thought that this might have to do with Eva's age and development
and wrote that they were trying to occupy Eva with other things (which
apparently succeeded for Eva wrote proudly - with a sample design that
she had painted decorations on the nursery furniture and that they
were now doing rafia work, mats etc, which was lots of fun. - You know
how satisfied we were to know Eva in such good hands, and I repeat
that both I and Stefan have full confidence in Mrs. Sch's power and
will of understanding for children and we know that she loves Eva more
than just as a ~~toto~~ boarder. One thing, however, might temporarily
have played part and that is the fact that in the beginning the
new house created a lot of difficulties for Mrs. Sch. and maybe
in that time she has not given so much time and patience to
the children as they were used to. But I tell you again - Eva's
last letter was very cheerful again, and my sister-in-law who
has been to see her lately wrote that too. So please don't worry more
than you can help, I honestly believe that there is no reason for it.
As soon as I hear from Mrs. Sch. again - she has broken her arm recently-
I shall let you know, but I feel sure things are alright again. -
About us Stefan has written. He somewhat exaggerates, I was not so very
bad although there was a kind of relapse again when I came here, but
this seems to be over and I am ready to climb all the mountains. These
are hardly any excursions as we know them from summer resorts, but
if you follow a smalles road you usually come into very beautiful
country with a great variety of views and nature. We have worked hard
lately and the autobiography is finished. I am still busy transcribing
corrections into the carbon copies but Stefan already works on some-
thing else and there is no time to get bored. On the household I don't
spend much time, my maid has learned quite a number of - in her opinion -
exotic dishes and the house itself gives little to do. We have had a few
fine days and on those I really got up between 6 and 7 because it was so
beautiful outside. On rainy days - and we had plenty - 9 seems early
enough. - I hope to hear in the next letter that Manfred got the job he
was looking for and that the Miller family really does all the work
for you in Bath so that you need not worry. Love and kisses Lotte,
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief von Lotte Zweig. Die Tinte ist gut lesbar, das Papier weist leichte Gebrauchsspuren auf.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, trotz der handschriftlichen Natur des Dokuments. Die wenigen Korrekturen (durchgestrichene Wörter) sind eindeutig identifizierbar.
